details: CONFIRMED. cmd_sync checks paid_due() for every non-dry sync regardless of the targets; `only={"agents"}` only assembles the
checkout's own agent files from roles/ (relay_rules.sync -> relay_roles.assemble_detail(ROOT)) and writes nothing the paid run
guards (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, projects' CLAUDE.local.md). With no record carrying a head yet, due always lists commits, so every
job that touches roles/ or agents is blocked: ordinary use. Size: 15.
evidence: git clone --no-local /Users/amidman/relay <scratch>/clone; checkout -B master origin/master; checkout -b wt/x 174c611
RELAY_HOME=<empty> CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<scratch> RELAY_PROJECTS=<empty> python3 bin/relay sync agents
-> relay sync: waits for a green paid run; merged since the last one:
104 commits in all, the newest 50 listed ...
failing_case: A worker edits roles/judge.md in a worktree and runs `<worktree>/bin/relay sync agents`, as the delegate skill's brief line
"Assembly:" (SKILL.md:54), docs/setup.md:112 and relay_roles' own messages ("run bin/relay sync agents from this checkout")
tell it to. Now: exit 1, "relay sync: waits for a green paid run; merged since the last one: no green run recorded ..." and the
agent files are not assembled, so the role edit cannot reach the agents and the roles check stays red. Should: assemble the
worktree's agent files (they go nowhere outside the worktree), exit 0.
fix_hint: Hold only when the sync would write a target outside the checkout: skip paid_due() when `only` is {"agents"} (or a subset of
in-repo targets). Add the agents-only case to tests/test_paid_batch.py SyncWaits.
pass_cases: 1. Repo with checked-path commits and no green record: `bin/relay sync agents` -> exit 0, agents assembled, no "waits for" line.
2. Same repo: `bin/relay sync` (no target) -> exit 1 with the due list, nothing written (test_sync_refuses_with_the_due_list... keeps passing).
3. Same repo: `bin/relay sync a` (a project target) -> exit 1 with the due list, target not written.
4. `bin/relay sync --dry` -> exit 0, plan printed (test_sync_dry_still_prints_its_plan keeps passing).
findings.summary: relay sync agents, the worker's assembly step in a worktree, is refused whenever anything is due (today always)

details: CONFIRMED for the verdict: report() counts only llm meaning graders as FAIL lines; a failed regex grader or a failed case
(aggregates casesPassed < casesTotal) never reaches "NOT A PASS". In the old flow that gap was masked because the run's verdict
was bin/ci's status (step "plugin evals" and the gate), not the record. The new `due` reads only the record, so the record's
verdict is now the gate for relay sync and for "is the wave covered". The brief's F4 says green is eval-record's own verdict;
the fix stays inside that decision by making the verdict complete (one function, used by main and due). PLAUSIBLE only for
whether `claude plugin eval` itself exits non-zero on that case (bin/ci then says red while due says green). Size: 15.
evidence: python3 (load bin/eval-record, is_green) over the six newest records:
failing_case: The newest stored record ~/.relay/evals/relay/2026-10-24T09-07-34Z-wt-py-rule.json: aggregates casesPassed 14 of 15, the
regex grader finds-the-contradiction of case spec-reviewer-flaw failed. is_green(record) -> True. With head/branch fields from
a wave run, `bin/paid-cost due` would print nothing and `relay sync` would write the texts, while the run failed an eval and
the front files a fix item for it. Should: not green, so the wave's commits stay due and sync waits.
fix_hint: In report(), count a failed grader of any type (or a case with passed false / casesPassed < casesTotal) as a failure that adds
the NOT A PASS line; is_green and main keep reading that one line. Test with a record whose only failure is a regex grader.
pass_cases: 1. Record whose only failure is a code (regex) grader with passed false in one run -> is_green False; due lists the commits after the previous green head.
2. Record with every grader passed, nothing missing, not partial -> is_green True; due prints nothing for commits up to its head.
3. Record with partial true -> is_green False (test_partial_batch_is_not_green keeps passing).
4. Record with an llm grader without three votes -> is_green False (test_not_judged_run_is_not_green keeps passing).
5. eval-record main exit code equals 0 exactly when is_green is True for the same data.
findings.summary: is_green calls a run green when a case failed on a code grader, so due counts a red paid run as covering the wave and relay sync goes ahead

details: CONFIRMED by reading: the check lives in cmd_sync only; the three other callers call relay_rules.sync directly. The owner's
decision is that rules reach the projects only after a green wave run ("relay sync waits for a green run"); these paths reach
the same targets. The brief names lib/relay_rules.py as the place of "the sync refusal", which would cover every caller.
Install on a fresh machine with no records would then refuse too: the fixer must decide whether install is exempt (it renders the
default branch head the owner chose to install) and say so. Size: 30.
evidence: git grep -n "relay_rules.sync" -> bin/relay:232 (improve adopt), bin/relay:328 (cmd_sync, guarded), bin/relay:398 (setup/migrate), lib/relay_setup.py:543 (install)
failing_case: After a wave merges rules/git.md and before its paid run, the owner runs `relay setup ~/proj` (bin/relay:398 syncs {proj, global})
or `relay improve adopt <candidate>` (bin/relay:232, full sync) or `relay install` (lib/relay_setup.py:543, global + agents).
Now: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and the project's CLAUDE.local.md are written from the unchecked rules/; only `relay sync` waits.
Should: the same wait as relay sync (refuse with the due list), or the command says it held the sync.
fix_hint: Move the paid_due check into relay_rules.sync (non-dry, a target outside the checkout in `only`), returning a held state per
target or raising, so every caller gets it; keep agents-only free (F1).
pass_cases: 1. Checked-path commit due: `relay improve adopt <name>` -> the global target is not written; the due list is printed; exit 1 (or the profile is adopted and the sync part is held with the list).
2. Checked-path commit due: `relay setup <dir>` -> global and project files not written; the due list printed.
3. Nothing due (green record at head): `relay setup <dir>` writes as today.
findings.summary: relay setup, relay migrate, relay improve adopt and relay install write the global CLAUDE.md from unchecked rules without waiting
